legacy_namespace_note: Phase2F registry follows user labels R0 historical, R1 current production. Phase2A called its object-centric relational proposal R1; Phase2F decomposes it into R3 object base plus R4 relation extension. Phase2A R0 corrected reference maps to Phase2F R1.

representation_reference.R0: historical 13G exact language and mismatched historical path; audit-only
representation_reference.R1: same ten programs under current Phase2C frozen test-blind execution; matched comparison baseline

primary_comparison: R1 vs R3 object-centric; R2 primitive-expanded and R4-R7 are specified secondary/component/hybrid alternatives.

common_task_data.existing_phase2c_set_confirmatory_use: diagnostic_only; all IDs have prior coverage/trace/invariant inspection
common_task_data.confirmatory_data_requirement: new authorized untouched common split; do not use historical Phase13G holdout as pristine

common_search_budget.composition_search_note: One complete program is one flat candidate; a bounded composed AST is one candidate, not iterative deepening.

common_fit_rule: All available training demonstration pairs must be reproduced exactly; first exact fit under deterministic order; no fit is NOT_FOUND_WITHIN_LANGUAGE_AND_BUDGET, never semantic impossibility.

statistics.report: win/loss/tie counts plus 95% paired bootstrap CI; predeclare seed, multiplicity handling, and practical delta before outputs
statistics.material_effect_threshold: must be preregistered before execution; not selected in this framework

required_before_run: implement each alternative and freeze code/grammar hashes
freeze shared independent task-family annotations or mark family-breadth endpoints unavailable
freeze a prospective paired task set disjoint from representation development
test coverage-only runner cannot access test outputs
verify identical budget, trace, downstream and evaluator contracts
positive-control HCC generator and oracle run
authorize any sealed accuracy evaluation separately
prohibited: claiming ARC accuracy from demo-fit coverage
using outcome-derived program labels as independent task-family labels
